title: phyllorkis medusae
intro: Phyllorkis medusae, commonly known as the Medusa's-tongue orchid, is a plant species in the orchid family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllorkis medusae include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
